create.name: Elayne Kalila Doughty
create.bio:
Elayne Kalila Doughty is a teacher of the Divine Feminine mysteries who holds a master's degree and trained as a marriage and family therapist. She is an ordained priestess of the 13 Moon Mystery School, an Avalonian lineage, and of the Rosa Mystica Mystery School, and before her spiritual work she wrote and directed theatre with prison inmates and ran programmes for women in difficult circumstances. In 2014 she founded the Priestess Presence Temple, an online sisterhood that has grown to tens of thousands of women.

As founder and dean of the Priestess Presence mystery schools, she trains and ordains women in the role of the modern-day priestess through ritual, ceremony, archetypes, shadow work and embodied practice. Much of her recent teaching centres on Mary Magdalene and the myrrhophores, the scent-priestess lineages of anointing with holy oils. She teaches through self-paced courses, year-long online initiations, pilgrimages and retreats, hosts The RED Podcast, and created the Magdalene Rose Oracle deck. Her Magdalene courses are also available on The Shift Network.

books.title: Magdalene Rose Oracle
books.author: Elayne Kalila Doughty
books.description: A 44-card oracle deck with guidebook, published by Flower of Life Press, built around the teachings of Mary Magdalene and the Divine Feminine. Each card carries a message and reflection questions for personal practice.

courses.title: Embark on a Sacred Pilgrimage to Experience the Healing Energies of Mary Magdalene
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course that follows the story and sacred sites of Mary Magdalene as a guide for inner spiritual practice. It combines teachings, meditations and ritual.

courses.title: The Magdalene Journey of Feminine Embodiment
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on the Magdalene as a guide through a 'descent' into the feminine underworld, using ritual, reflection and embodiment practices to reclaim presence and power.

courses.title: The Magdalene Initiation
courses.description: An eleven-module self-paced video course that introduces the Magdalene Sanctuary as an inner temple, with nine empowerments and ceremonial practices. It includes the seven-module introductory programme.

courses.title: Answering The Call: 9 Sacred Priestess Practices
courses.description: A self-study immersion in nine core skills and rituals of the modern-day priestess, based on the teachings of the 13 Moon Mystery School. Includes formal teachings, practices and a private online community.

courses.title: The Illuminated Priestess
courses.description: A nine-part self-study series on the 'alchemical priestess', a Divine Feminine archetype, and the stages of its emergence in the student's own life.

courses.title: Activating the 5 Faces of Priestess Leadership
courses.description: A five-week self-study course in feminine leadership, working with five priestess leadership archetypes such as the mystic, the ecstatic and the shaman.

courses.title: The Path of the Alchemical Priestess: Enter the Mystery Foundation
courses.description: A self-paced foundation programme drawn from the Priestess Presence mystery school, with meditations, teachings, skill trainings and workbooks on archetypes, alchemy, shadow work and temple culture.

courses.title: Magdalene, The Alchemist of Love
courses.description: A recorded day-long retreat in the Rosa Mystica tradition, working with the symbolism of the six-petalled rose, personal anointing oils and core Magdalene teachings.

courses.title: Rosa Mystica Mystery School: Lineages of the Scent Priestess (Year 1)
courses.description: A twelve-month online initiation into the scent-priestess lineages, with three live online temples a month, mentoring and a set of holy anointing oils posted to each student. Co-led with Diana DuBrow and the Rosa Mystica faculty.

free_resources.title: What is a Modern Day Priestess? Free 5-Part Mini Video Course
free_resources.description: A free five-part video course introducing the modern-day priestess path, with a workbook and a guided meditation. Access is by email sign-up.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @ElayneKalila 2.37K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram @elayne.kalila and Facebook elaynekaliladoughty counts could not be read (no counts served to curl/WebFetch) → readable total ~2.4k → local_hero
flags: Instagram and Facebook follower counts could not be read; her Priestess Presence community is described as 80,000–100,000+ women (a mailing list/sisterhood, not followers), so local_hero may understate her reach — a human should check.
The email support@priestesspresence.com is the school's support address, published in the refund terms of a course page; there is no personal address. Her personal site has a contact form.
The YouTube avatar (red veil, blonde hair) and the Shift headshot (auburn hair) look like the same woman but are years apart; fairly confident, but worth a glance.
Magdalene Rose Oracle shows as 'Currently unavailable' on amazon.com, although the listing (ASIN B0C8RQC546) is live.
The Rosa Mystica Year 1 programme is co-taught (Diana DuBrow leads the scent-priestess lineage teaching).
Her Shift course 'Embark on a Sacred Pilgrimage to Experience the Healing Energies of Mary Magdalene' has 'Healing Energies' in the title but names no condition; kept.
Shift prices for the two seven-module courses are sale prices ($247; regular $297).
left_out: Shift: The Magdalene Frequency (live course that started 18 Aug 2026; late registration only; its page also frames the work as trauma-informed healing).
Avalon Remembered Pilgrimage, Glastonbury, 9–16 July 2027 (sold out).
In-Person Scent Priestess Training (April and Sept 2027) — mainly Diana DuBrow's anointing certification; left out to keep to Elayne's own teaching.

Videos: 'What The Sisters Say: Healing Shame…' testimonials, Samhain Ritual Celebration 2018 (dated), Samhain Invitation, early RED Podcast guest episodes (guest is main speaker; one on menopause), and interviews on other channels (Layla Martin, Glastonbury Goddess Conference etc.) where she is a guest.

Books: Sacred Call of the Ancient Priestess (sold as an eBook on her own site; no Amazon listing found); Voices of the Avalonian Priestesses and The Path of the Priestess (anthologies she contributed to; not verified on Amazon); Magdalene Unveiled (she wrote only the foreword).
Free quizzes (13 Faces of the Divine Feminine, 6 Faces of Magdalene) — quizzes, not a listed resource type.
